capture: Requests ideal 3840x2160 and up to 30fps; actual source dimensions are respected and shown, without changing display settings

checks: Standalone secure local protocol; renderer has no Node.js or picker IPC access; only listed assets served
Native download handling saves JSON/PNG/WebM; edited 2-second WebM decodes at 1280x720
1080p: PNG and real decoded WebM 1920x1080; focus geometry and project restore; selected resolution survives import
1440p: PNG and real decoded WebM 2560x1440; focus geometry and project restore; selected resolution survives import
2160p: PNG and real decoded WebM 3840x2160; focus geometry and project restore; selected resolution survives import
Version 1 project migrates to 720p with its original edits

Real Windows window capture of test-owned fixture; stop, save, decode: 1180x696, 2.11 seconds

limitations: System Save As UI bypassed only by test harness setSavePath; production uses Save As

High-resolution encoding uses a generated 720p demo as the source: verifies output pixels, not recovered 4K source detail

visual_inspection: Reviewed desktop-4k-preview.png: resolution selector, 4K badge, source dimensions, timeline and controls are visible; frame geometry preserved.
measured_scope: Resolution results include short generated-video file sizes and end-to-end export wall time during validation; this is not a sustained-performance benchmark.
limitations: Real-time MediaRecorder output timing is approximate; 1.5-second test ranges decoded as 1.437, 1.403 and 1.382 seconds respectively. No frame-accurate export claim.
The source for high-resolution export checks is the 720p generated demo. Output dimensions are verified, but upscaling cannot add original source detail.
Native 2K/4K screen capture, long 4K recording, sustained frame rate, CPU and peak process memory are not measured.
Recording and export retain the two-minute limit and a 256 MiB encoded-chunk budget. Stop/cancel behavior is implemented; the full-budget stress case is not exercised.
No audio, camera, MP4, multiple zoom regions or automatic pointer tracking.
Native Save As was exercised in 0.2; 0.3 export tests direct files to a test folder through the same download handler.
Older verification files remain their historical version snapshots.
